sloka: जवेनाप्लुत्य च पुनस्तद्बलं रक्षसां महत्।अभ्ययात् प्रत्यरिबलं पतङ्गा इव पावकम् ।। ६.७५.५९ ।।
transliteration: javenāplutya ca punastadbalaṁ rakṣasāṁ mahat।abhyayāt pratyaribalaṁ pataṅgā iva pāvakam ।। 6.75.59 ।।

translations.english: Crowded with fierce warriors coming like thundering rainy clouds, the Rakshasas, and the monkey troops coming forward made loud noises with an elevated tone.
